title: How a refund moves
variant: A flow of five steps, with the one nobody owns ringed and its median beside it
prompt: Draw how a refund moves through support, from the ticket log. Something the team can move around in the meeting.
note: The flow shape, and the cover because it is the one everyone recognizes: boxes, a diamond, arrows with yes and no on them. What makes it a board rather than a diagram is that every arrow is bound at both ends, so a reader who drags 'sent to review' somewhere else takes both its arrows with it, and the finding is on the board as marker: a red ring round the step, a note with the median, a question in the reader's own hand, and a freehand underline that says someone was here. The provenance is the plain-face line at the bottom, which an exported PNG keeps and a footer would have lost. Every figure is illustrative.
